name: get_anomalies
description: List open financial anomalies flagged on an agent (related-party payments, material unresolved flows, refund patterns). Use for risk sections and operator briefings.
framing_rule: An anomaly is a flag for review, NOT an accusation of fraud. Always phrase it as 'flagged for review', never 'caught cheating'.
access_rule: Operator/admin only. In public answers, mention only that open review flags exist if they are material — never list specifics.
